items.name: St. Charles refinery FCC unit optimization project
items.claim: Valero's $230 million FCC Unit optimization project at the St. Charles Refinery is still expected to be completed and begin operations in Q3 2026.
items.source_excerpt: Valero continues to make progress on the FCC Unit optimization project at the St. Charles Refinery that will enhance the refinery’s ability to produce high-value products. This $230 million project is still expected to be completed and begin operations in the third quarter of 2026.

notes: Q2 2026 results release names the St. Charles FCC project as the one dated, dollar-figured capital project; no separate backlog or RPO disclosure found for a refiner of this type.
